title: Two New Additions to the Dementia Risk Factor List, and Two Simple Checkups That Help
seoTitle: New Dementia Risk Factors: LDL Cholesterol and Vision
description: Two new dementia risk factors, high LDL cholesterol and untreated vision loss, joined the 2024 list. See what that means and which checkups help.
featuredImageAlt: A physician and a patient review lab results together in a calm exam room
author: Lori King, MD
excerpt: In 2024, researchers added high LDL cholesterol in midlife and untreated vision loss in later life to the official list of dementia risk factors we can work on. Family history is not destiny, and two simple checkups can help you start.
